var playButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".click-btn");
var closeButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".modal .btn-close");
// Play video when clicking the play button
playButtons.forEach(function (button) {
button.addEventListener("click", function () {
var targetModalID = button.getAttribute("data-target"); // Get modal ID
var modal = document.querySelector(targetModalID);
if (!modal) return;
var iframe = modal.querySelector(".video-iframe");
if (iframe) {
var videoSrc = iframe.getAttribute("data-src");
if (videoSrc) {
iframe.src = videoSrc; // Set video source
}
}
});
});
// Remove `src` when closing the modal (Ensures video stops completely)
closeButtons.forEach(function (button) {
button.addEventListener("click", function () {
var modal = button.closest(".modal");
var iframe = modal.querySelector(".video-iframe");
if (iframe) {
var videoSrc = iframe.getAttribute("data-src"); // Save original `data-src`
iframe.src = ""; // Temporarily clear src (stops video)
setTimeout(() => {
iframe.removeAttribute("src"); // Completely remove `src`
iframe.setAttribute("data-src", videoSrc); // Restore `data-src`
}, 100); // Delay to ensure video stops
}
});
});
});
